segments.name: Personal Banking
segments.description: Provides financial products and services to retail clients in Canada, the Caribbean and the U.S.
segments.evidence: Personal Banking Provides a broad suite of financial products and services to retail clients in Canada, the Caribbean and the U.S.

segments.name: Commercial Banking
segments.description: Serves Canadian businesses with lending, deposits, payments, cash management and advisory services.
segments.evidence: Commercial Banking Serves the end-to-end needs of Canadian businesses, including subsidiaries of multi-nationals.

segments.name: Wealth Management
segments.description: Serves affluent and high-net-worth clients with wealth, investment, trust, banking and credit solutions globally.
segments.evidence: Wealth Management Primarily serves affluent, high-net-worth (HNW) and ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) clients from our offices in key financial centres across the globe.

segments.name: Insurance
segments.description: Offers life, health, property and casualty, travel, group benefits and reinsurance solutions.
segments.evidence: Insurance Offers a comprehensive suite of advice and solutions for individual and business clients including life, health, wealth solutions, property & casualty, travel, group benefits, longevity reinsurance and reinsurance solutions for creditor products.

segments.name: Capital Markets
segments.description: Provides advisory, sales and trading, lending and transaction banking to corporate and institutional clients globally.
segments.evidence: Capital Markets Provides expertise in advisory & origination, sales & trading, lending & financing and transaction banking to corporate, institutional, sponsor and government clients globally.

revenueModel.text: Interest income from loans and deposits, fees from wealth management and transaction services, insurance premiums, and trading revenues.

changes.text: In 2024, HSBC Bank Canada was acquired and consolidated into Personal Banking, Commercial Banking, Wealth Management and Capital Markets segments.
changes.evidence: On March 28, 2024, we completed the acquisition of HSBC Bank Canada (HSBC Canada transaction).
